description: This Java class 'EntityEcaAction' defines an entity event condition action within the Apache OFBiz framework. It encapsulates logic to execute service calls (synchronously or asynchronously) based on entity events, with configurable parameters such as service name, mode, user context, and error handling behavior.

classes.name: EntityEcaAction
classes.description: A final class implementing Serializable that manages execution of service actions triggered by entity events, with configurable parameters for service invocation, user context, and error handling.

methods.name: EntityEcaAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the action parameters from an XML Element, reading attributes such as service, mode, user, and error handling flags.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action, handling synchronous or asynchronous modes, user context, and error management based on class properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, listing non-empty configuration attributes.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the object's properties for use in hash-based collections.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityEcaAction object based on all configuration properties.
